about_the_game:
A Melancholic Melody from the Perspective of the Undead

This track gently encapsulates the world of the Dead Rising series through the eyes of its true stars—the zombies. Their aimless existence, caught between life and death, mirrors the monotony of our own daily lives.

In Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster, you can break free from the mundane and embrace the chaotic, unrestrained gameplay. Say goodbye to those dreary days and dive into a world where anything is possible!
